pokedexEntries.bk: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and attack their foes with violent blizzards.

pokedexEntries.wh: If both heads get angry simultaneously, this Pokémon expels a blizzard, burying everything in snow.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and, when angry, cause violent blizzards.

pokedexEntries.x: If both heads get angry simultaneously, this Pokémon expels a blizzard, burying everything in snow.

pokedexEntries.or: If both heads get angry simultaneously, this Pokémon expels a blizzard, burying everything in snow.

pokedexEntries.y: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and, when angry, cause violent blizzards.

pokedexEntries.as: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and, when angry, cause violent blizzards.

pokedexEntries.su: Each of its two heads has a brain, and when they are in agreement, it attacks its enemies by exhaling a violent blizzard.

pokedexEntries.mo: Even if it loses one of its heads, it can live relatively problem-free. It makes snow clouds inside its body.

pokedexEntries.us: It blasts blizzards from its two mouths. It can create snow anywhere, so it gets a lot of love from skiers and snowboarders.

pokedexEntries.um: Vanilluxe is born when two Vanillish, half-melted by the day’s light, stick to each other and freeze together in the cold return of night.

pokedexEntries.sw: When its anger reaches a breaking point, this Pokémon unleashes a fierce blizzard that freezes every creature around it, be they friend or foe.

pokedexEntries.sh: People believe this Pokémon formed when two Vanillish stuck together. Its body temperature is roughly 21 degrees Fahrenheit.

pokedexEntries.za: If both heads get angry simultaneously, this Pokémon expels a blizzard from its horn, burying everything in snow.
